import {aiuxFetch} from '@servicenow/aiux-components-core';

// Only set when globalThis.g_ck is truthy — a browser global the platform
// injects at hydration. Server-side (SSR/Node), it's undefined, and sending
// an empty 'X-UserToken' header overrides the framework's own correctly
// resolved SSR token (caller headers win over injected ones), causing every
// server-side request to 401.
function authHeaders(): Record<string, string> {
  return globalThis.g_ck ? {'X-UserToken': globalThis.g_ck} : {};
}

export class HttpClient {
  private readonly _fetchFn: typeof globalThis.fetch;

  constructor() {
    this._fetchFn = aiuxFetch as typeof globalThis.fetch;
  }

  async get<T = unknown>(url: string): Promise<T> {
    const response = await this._fetchFn(url, {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        ...authHeaders()
      },
      credentials: 'same-origin'
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  async post<T = unknown>(url: string, body: unknown): Promise<T> {
    const response = await this._fetchFn(url, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        ...authHeaders()
      },
      credentials: 'same-origin',
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
    }

    return response.json();
  }
}

import {html, nothing} from 'lit';
import {Directive, directive, PartType} from 'lit/directive.js';
import {ifDefined} from 'lit/directives/if-defined.js';
import iconMapping from './iconMapping.js';

/** @typedef {'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '1x' | '2x' | '3x'} IconSize */
/** @typedef {'fill' | 'outline'} IconVariant */

/**
 * Size mappings for icons.
 * Maps component size prop to icon object keys and pixel dimensions.
 */
export const ICON_SIZES = {
  xs: {pixelSize: 12, key: 'xs'},
  sm: {pixelSize: 16, key: 'sm'},
  md: {pixelSize: 20, key: 'md'},
  lg: {pixelSize: 24, key: 'lg'},
  xl: {pixelSize: 32, key: 'xl'},
  '1x': {pixelSize: 16, key: 'sm'},
  '2x': {pixelSize: 24, key: 'lg'},
  '3x': {pixelSize: 32, key: 'xl'}
};

/** @type {IconVariant[]} */
const VARIANTS = ['fill', 'outline'];
/** @type {IconVariant} */
const DEFAULT_VARIANT = 'fill';

/**
 * Extract base name and variant from an icon name string.
 * @param {string} iconName - e.g. "user", "user-fill", "user-outline"
 * @param {IconVariant} [defaultVariant='fill'] - Fallback variant when no suffix
 * @returns {{ baseName: string, variant: IconVariant }}
 */
export function getBaseNameAndVariant(
  iconName,
  defaultVariant = DEFAULT_VARIANT
) {
  const match = iconName.match(/^(.+)-(fill|outline)$/);
  return {
    baseName: match ? match[1] : iconName,
    variant: match ? match[2] : defaultVariant
  };
}

/**
 * Parse icon name to extract base name and variant.
 * Maps legacy icon names (e.g., Font Awesome) to current names by baseName,
 * so "cog_outline" correctly resolves to { baseName: 'gear', variant: 'outline' }.
 * @param {IconNameWithVariant} iconName - Icon name like "user", "user-fill", or "user-outline"
 * @returns {{ baseName: string, variant: IconVariant } | null}
 */
export function parseIconName(iconName) {
  if (!iconName) return null;
  const normalized = iconName.replace(/_/g, '-');
  const {baseName, variant} = getBaseNameAndVariant(normalized);
  if (baseName in iconMapping) {
    return getBaseNameAndVariant(iconMapping[baseName], variant);
  }
  return {baseName, variant};
}

/** @typedef {import('../types/__generated__/icon-names.js').IconName} IconName */
/** @typedef {import('../types/__generated__/icon-names.js').IconNameWithVariant} IconNameWithVariant */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} IconOptions
 * @property {IconNameWithVariant} name - Icon name, optionally with variant suffix
 *   (e.g., 'user', 'home-fill', 'user-outline', 'circle_info_outline').
 * @property {IconSize} [size='md'] - Icon size.
 * @property {string} [alt] - Accessible label. When provided the SVG gets
 *   `role="img"` and `aria-label`; otherwise `aria-hidden="true"`.
 * @property {string} [class] - CSS classes to apply to the SVG element.
 */

/**
 * IconDirective
 *
 * A child-position Lit directive that renders an inline SVG `<use>` icon
 * referencing the platform sprite sheet. Eliminates the Shadow DOM overhead
 * of the `<aiux-icon>` custom element while keeping the same visual output.
 *
 * @example
 *   import {icon} from '@servicenow/aiux/aiux-directive-icon';
 *
 *   html`${icon({name: 'user', size: 'lg'})}`
 *   html`${icon({name: 'home-outline', alt: 'Home'})}`
 */
class IconDirective extends Directive {
  constructor(partInfo) {
    super(partInfo);
    if (partInfo.type !== PartType.CHILD) {
      throw new Error(
        'icon() must be used in a child expression: html`${icon(...)}`'
      );
    }
  }

  /** @param {IconOptions} options */
  render(options) {
    const {name, alt} = options;
    if (!name) return nothing;

    const parsed = parseIconName(name);
    if (!parsed) return nothing;

    const size = options.size || 'md';
    const effectiveSize = ICON_SIZES[size] ? size : 'md';
    const sizeConfig = ICON_SIZES[effectiveSize];
    const variant = VARIANTS.includes(parsed.variant)
      ? parsed.variant
      : DEFAULT_VARIANT;
    const spriteHref = `/aiux/assets/core/icons/${parsed.baseName}.svg#${variant}-${sizeConfig.key}`;
    const cls = options.class;

    const hasLabel = !!alt;
    const baseStyle =
      'color:currentColor;vertical-align:middle;display:inline-block;flex-shrink:0';
    const style = hasLabel
      ? `${baseStyle};cursor:help;border-radius:0.25rem`
      : baseStyle;

    return html`<svg
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      class=${ifDefined(cls || undefined)}
      width=${sizeConfig.pixelSize}
      height=${sizeConfig.pixelSize}
      viewBox="0 0 ${sizeConfig.pixelSize} ${sizeConfig.pixelSize}"
      role=${ifDefined(hasLabel ? 'img' : undefined)}
      aria-hidden=${ifDefined(hasLabel ? undefined : 'true')}
      aria-label=${ifDefined(hasLabel ? alt : undefined)}
      tabindex=${ifDefined(hasLabel ? '0' : undefined)}
      style=${style}
    >
      <use href=${spriteHref}></use>
    </svg>`;
  }
}

export const icon = directive(IconDirective);
export {IconDirective};

  'kb_knowledge.sys_id'?: string;
  'kb_knowledge.number'?: string;
  'kb_knowledge.short_description'?: string;
};

  sysId: string;

/**
 * AIUX port of the classic `attached_knowledge` sys_ui_macro
 * (glide-knowledge, sys_id cfb860d20a0a0b1f01f93f82ffaee858), which lists
 * kb_knowledge records linked to a task via m2m_kb_task.
 *
 * Extends `AIUXWidgetElement` directly (not a shared app-internal base
 * class) because the SDK's widget-metadata build only recognizes a class
 * that *directly* extends `AIUXElement`/`AIUXWidgetElement` in its own
 * entry-file AST — it does not follow inheritance through another module.
 * See `KMWidget`/`KMProvider` for the app's own in-page widget system,
 * which this intentionally does not use.
 */
@customElement('aiux-attached-knowledge-widget')
@explicitSysId('15fb6d1bac5833f6068d5fa8dc605474')
@discoverable(true)
@name('Attached Knowledge')
@description('Displays knowledge articles attached to a task record (m2m_kb_task).')
@bestFor('Showing KB articles linked to a task via m2m_kb_task on a record form.')
export default class AttachedKnowledgeWidget extends AIUXWidgetElement {
  // No `@server` script and no SSR data path implemented — this widget
  // fetches purely client-side, so it opts out of SSR and connect-time
  // auto-fetch rather than silently rendering an SSR/hydration mismatch.
  static readonly ssr = false;
  static override readonly fetchDataOnConnect = false;

  @property({type: String})
  taskSysId = '';

  @state()
  private _articles: AttachedArticle[] | undefined;

  private _fetchGeneration = 0;

  override updated(changedProperties: PropertyValues<this>): void {
    super.updated(changedProperties);
    if (changedProperties.has('taskSysId')) {
      this._fetchArticles();
    }
  }

  private async _fetchArticles(): Promise<void> {
    const generation = ++this._fetchGeneration;

    if (!this.taskSysId) {
      this._articles = [];
      return;
    }

    const httpClient = new HttpClient();
    const query = `task=${this.taskSysId}^ORDERBYkb_knowledge.number`;
    const fields =
      'kb_knowledge.sys_id,kb_knowledge.number,kb_knowledge.short_description';
    const url =
      `/api/now/table/m2m_kb_task?sysparm_query=${encodeURIComponent(query)}` +
      `&sysparm_fields=${encodeURIComponent(fields)}` +
      `&sysparm_display_value=true`;

    try {
      const raw = await httpClient.get<AttachedKnowledgeRawData>(url);
      if (generation !== this._fetchGeneration) return; // stale response
      this._articles = this._hydrate(raw);
    } catch (error) {
      if (generation !== this._fetchGeneration) return; // stale response
      log.error(
        {error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)},
        'failed to fetch attached knowledge'
      );
      this._articles = [];
    }
  }

  private _hydrate(data: AttachedKnowledgeRawData): AttachedArticle[] {
    return (data.result || [])
      .map(row => ({
        sysId: row['kb_knowledge.sys_id'] || '',
        number: row['kb_knowledge.number'] || '',
        shortDescription: row['kb_knowledge.short_description'] || ''
      }))
      .filter(article => article.sysId);
  }

  private _articleUrl(article: AttachedArticle): string {
    return `/kb?id=kb_article_view&sys_kb_id=${article.sysId}`;
  }

  override render() {
    const articles = this._articles;

    if (!articles) {
      return html`<div class="aiux-card p-6">
        <span class="aiux-loading aiux-loading-spinner aiux-loading-sm"></span>
      </div>`;
    }

    if (articles.length === 0) {
      return nothing;
    }

    const TITLE_TEXT = i18n.getMessage('Attached knowledge:');

    return html`
      <div class="aiux-card">
        <div class="aiux-card-body p-4">
          <div class="text-sm font-semibold mb-2">${TITLE_TEXT}</div>
          <div class="space-y-2">
            ${articles.map(
              article => html`
                <a
                  class="flex items-center gap-2 hover:bg-base-200 rounded-lg p-1 -ml-1 aiux-link text-sm"
                  href=${this._articleUrl(article)}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                >
                  <span aria-hidden="true"
                    >${icon({name: 'document-outline', size: 'xs'})}</span
                  >
                  <span>${article.number} - ${article.shortDescription}</span>
                </a>
              `
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }
}
